_о_файле: Три сериала по десять серий: одна серия в сутки, серия идёт на ВСЕ пять
пачек одним файлом - разная только музыка, обложка, хук и кодовое слово.
У сериала СВОИ персонажи, лица лент тут не участвуют (решение владельца).
Моменты - это биты серии. Каждый разворачивается в 2-3 кадра (общий,
деталь, реакция), и 18 кадров по 3 секунды дают серию около минуты.
Арки написаны сессией: мозг завода это сессия, а не серверная модель.

mirror.героиня: Lena, 24, photo retoucher, lives alone in a rented studio flat
mirror.внешность: dark blonde hair to the shoulders, grey eyes, thin silver chain
mirror.мир: a rainy northern city, late autumn, neon shop signs, old tram lines
mirror.завязка: She finds a social account that posts photos of her she never took.

серии.тема: She sees the first photo of herself
моменты: phone screen in the dark, a notification from an unknown account
the photo on screen is her own kitchen, taken from inside
she looks up at the real kitchen, the same angle, empty
she checks the window latch, it is closed
a new notification arrives while she stands there
the second photo shows her standing exactly like this
серии.клиффхэнгер: The newest photo was taken seconds ago.

серии.тема: She tries to find who posted it
моменты: morning, she scrolls the account on a tram
every photo is from a place only she has been
the account has no name and no followers
she writes a message, it is read instantly
the reply is a photo of her on this tram
she looks up at the other passengers
серии.клиффхэнгер: Nobody on the tram is holding a phone.

серии.тема: She asks a friend for help
моменты: a cafe, she shows the account to her friend Mia
Mia says the photos look edited, not taken
they compare two shots of the same room, the light differs
Mia finds a watermark corner nobody cropped
the watermark is a bot handle
Lena opens the bot for the first time
серии.клиффхэнгер: The bot already knows her name.

моменты: she types one question into the chat
the bot sends back a photo of her from a year ago
she never uploaded that photo anywhere
she asks where it came from, the chat goes quiet
a new image appears, her flat from the ceiling
she looks up at the ceiling corner
серии.клиффхэнгер: There is a small dark circle in the plaster.

моменты: night, she stands on a chair with a torch
the circle is a hole, drilled from above
the upstairs flat has been empty for months
she goes up the stairwell, the door is unlocked
inside the empty flat there is one chair facing the floor
beside the chair, a phone on a charger
серии.клиффхэнгер: The phone screen lights up with her face.

моменты: she carries the phone down to her own flat
the gallery holds thousands of photos of her
the earliest one is from three years ago, another city
she was not living here three years ago
the newest one is from this minute, and she is in it
she turns around slowly
серии.клиффхэнгер: The hole in her ceiling is gone, plastered over.

моменты: a police desk, she shows the phone
the officer scrolls and finds the gallery empty
on her own screen the photos are still there
she photographs the screen, the copy comes out blank
outside, Mia is waiting with bad news
Mia has started getting the photos too
серии.клиффхэнгер: In Mia's photos, Lena is the one taking them.

моменты: an address written on the back of a printed photo
a storage unit at the edge of the city
inside, printed photos cover every wall
the walls follow her whole life in order
the last wall is empty except one pinned note
the note has tomorrow's date
серии.клиффхэнгер: The date is in her own handwriting.

моменты: morning, she goes back to the storage unit
the empty wall is now covered with today
every photo shows her walking here, step by step
the final photo shows her reaching for the light switch
she reaches for the light switch anyway
behind the door, a second room she has not seen
серии.клиффхэнгер: The second room is her own flat, rebuilt exactly.

моменты: in the rebuilt flat, the ceiling has the same hole
she climbs up and looks through it
through the hole she sees herself, asleep in her real bed
the phone in her hand takes a photo by itself
the photo posts to the account instantly
she understands who has been posting
серии.клиффхэнгер: Season two: the account now has a second follower.

thirty.героиня: Ira, 27, night shift nurse, sharp, tired, practical
thirty.внешность: black hair in a low bun, brown eyes, hospital scrubs off duty
thirty.мир: a coastal city in summer, hospital corridors, empty beaches at dawn
thirty.завязка: Every photo the bot returns shows what happens thirty seconds later.

моменты: hospital locker room, she sends a selfie to the bot
the photo comes back with a spilled coffee on her sleeve
her sleeve is clean, she laughs and closes the chat
half a minute later a passing trolley hits her arm
coffee spreads across the same sleeve
she stares at the photo again
серии.клиффхэнгер: The photo matches the stain exactly.

моменты: a stairwell, she sends another photo on purpose
the result shows her holding the rail, looking down
she decides not to hold the rail
someone bumps her, she grabs the rail anyway
she looks down the stairwell, exactly as in the photo
a new result arrives unasked
серии.клиффхэнгер: In it, she is standing in the rain at night.

моменты: end of shift, the sky is clear
she walks home the long way to avoid it
a sprinkler system bursts over the pavement
she stands soaked under the water, exactly framed
the bot sends the next one before she dries off
this one shows a hospital bed with someone in it
серии.клиффхэнгер: She cannot see the face.

моменты: night shift, the bed from the photo is empty
she waits beside it, phone in hand
an alarm goes off in another wing
she runs, and the new photo arrives mid-run
it shows the bed again, now occupied
she turns back
серии.клиффхэнгер: The patient in the bed is her colleague.

моменты: break room, she shows the bot to a doctor
he sends his own photo as a joke
the result shows him dropping his badge
he holds the badge tightly and laughs
the badge clip snaps on its own
he stops laughing
серии.клиффхэнгер: He asks her to send one more, about tonight.

моменты: she photographs the corridor, not herself
the result shows a stretcher coming through the doors
the doors stay shut for a long moment
then they open exactly as pictured
she looks at the patient and recognises the face
it is the man from the break room
серии.клиффхэнгер: He left the hospital an hour ago.

моменты: she calls him, no answer
she photographs the exit, the result shows an empty road
she runs to the road, a car is already stopped
the driver is on the phone, unhurt
behind the car, the photo's empty road is still empty
the bot sends one she did not request
серии.клиффхэнгер: It shows her own hospital room.

моменты: dawn, she sits in the pictured room
nothing happens for a long time
she falls asleep in the chair
the phone keeps sending while she sleeps
each new photo is thirty seconds further ahead
the last one is hours away
серии.клиффхэнгер: In it, the chair is empty and the bed is not.

моменты: she wakes to a full gallery
she scrolls backwards instead of forwards
an older photo shows the locker room, day one
in that photo, someone is standing behind her
she zooms in on the figure
the figure is holding a phone up
серии.клиффхэнгер: The figure is wearing her scrubs.

моменты: she returns to the locker room at the same hour
she stands where the figure stood
her own reflection lifts a phone it is not holding
she takes one photo of the mirror
the result arrives with no delay at all
it shows the corridor, empty, and a door closing
серии.клиффхэнгер: Season two: the delay is gone.

guest.героиня: Dasha, 22, travel blogger, bright on camera, nervous off it
guest.внешность: copper hair, freckles, camera strap always on her shoulder
guest.мир: an off-season seaside hotel, long corridors, half-empty restaurant
guest.завязка: Someone in the hotel is sending her photos from inside her room.

моменты: reception, she is the only guest arriving
room 408, the key is an old metal one
she films a quick clip for her feed
a photo arrives from an unknown number
it is her room, filmed from the wardrobe
she opens the wardrobe
серии.клиффхэнгер: Inside, the hangers are still swinging.

моменты: morning, empty restaurant, she eats alone
a photo arrives of her table from the doorway
the doorway is empty when she looks
she asks the waiter who else is staying
the waiter says nobody, for two weeks
a third photo shows the waiter's back
серии.клиффхэнгер: In the photo, the waiter is looking at her.

моменты: she asks for another room, gets 212
she checks the wardrobe first this time
nothing, and she almost relaxes
the next photo is from under the bed
she lifts the bedspread with one hand
a phone is taped to the slats
серии.клиффхэнгер: The phone is recording.

моменты: she takes the taped phone to the lobby
no signal, no password, no owner
the gallery has rooms, not people
every room in the hotel, in order
408 and 212 are both there
the last folder is tonight
серии.клиффхэнгер: Tonight's folder is already full.

моменты: she sits awake with the lights on
the folder updates as the hours pass
each photo is from a different corner
she covers every corner with towels
the next photo is from above the towels
she looks up at the smoke detector
серии.клиффхэнгер: The detector has no battery in it.

моменты: the bus stop, off-season timetable
no bus for four hours, she waits anyway
a photo arrives of the bus stop bench
it was taken from the hotel roof
she walks back and goes up to the roof
the roof door is open
серии.клиффхэнгер: On the roof, her own camera is set on a tripod.

моменты: she recognises the strap and the dent
her camera is still in her bag downstairs
both cameras exist and both are hers
the roof camera is full of her last two years
cities she filmed, rooms she stayed in
the newest file is from this roof, this minute
серии.клиффхэнгер: She is not in that frame.

моменты: the reception desk at night, nobody there
she opens the old paper guest book
her name is written in it twice
the second entry is dated next week
the handwriting is the same both times
she turns the page
серии.клиффхэнгер: Every page after is her name.

моменты: she goes back to the first room
the key still turns, the room is made up
her things are unpacked on the shelf
she never unpacked them here
the wardrobe door stands slightly open
she looks inside properly this time
серии.клиффхэнгер: There is a corridor behind the wardrobe.

моменты: the corridor runs the length of the hotel
peepholes open into every room
a chair sits before the one into 408
on the chair, a phone and a folded coat
the coat is the one she travelled in
through the peephole she sees her room, and herself in it
серии.клиффхэнгер: Season two: the chair is still warm.
